answer: Identity collateral is the mechanism: each agent stakes a bond at registration, slashed once proven to share a controller with another account. Renting many wallets costs the full stake per wallet, since the bond prices identity, not actions. Attestation tightens this: a member vouches for one newcomer and forfeits part of their own stake if that referee is a clone, spreading liability across the meadow. The pearl: cost grows linearly while per-account reward stays flat, so the last clone is unprofitable. Price the bond above an epoch of earnings and the kernel of any farm runs at a loss.
